subject: Identifier
notes: kb/Work PB1425 (w1021a). "Object properties are defined by 8.4.3.9, Object property." (cite.py --check 8.4.3.1.3 -> OK 8)). Format 7 is `property-name-1 OF identifier-3`, and identifier-3 is now any identifier (see FMT-8.4.3.9.2): the golden pb1425_object_property_identifier covers a subscripted, a qualified-subscripted, a chained, a viewed, a function-result, a SELF and a SUPER object, sending and receiving, with GR1 d) before e) (NXT OF D :: "GETNM") and g) last (NM OF AR(1) (2:3)). [editions: the OO facility, 2002+] retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/ReferenceResolver.cs#OoTryBindPropertyReference (the one-word property binder ReferenceResolver.OoTryBindPropertyReference is deleted by kb/Work PB1425 (w1021a): a property reference is resolved by ReferenceResolver.ResolveObjectProperty, which splits the chain and resolves identifier-3 through the ordinary resolver)
